study.title: Weed Instance Segmentation from UAV ortho-mosaic Images based on Deep Learning
study.short_title: YOLOv8/Mask R-CNN weed instance seg in potato fields

segmentation.best_model: Mask R-CNN segm AP50 0.920 (highest mAP); YOLOv8 faster convergence, segm AP50 0.902

dataset.name: Self-collected potato-field orthomosaic (Duerast field, Freising, Germany)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 RTK, 10 m AGL, 2 m/s, GSD 0.27 cm/px, 5472x3648 RGB images, weekly across growing season; orthomosaic via Agisoft Metashape; clipped to 640x640 tiles; 130 train (659 potato + 934 weed instances = 1593) + 20 val (82 potato + 138 weed = 220) images; SAM-assisted semi-automatic annotation (AnyLabeling); Real-ESRGAN 2x super-resolution for enhancement. Weed treatments: control/chemical/robotic/mechanical.

mIoU.quote: YOLOv8 Original Model: ... MIOU: 0.5150 (Fig 11); SR model MIOU 0.5116; SR+MW model MIOU 0.5089
mIoU.ambiguity: Pixel-level metrics appear only in Figure 11 caption (instance-seg mask evaluation). Primary evaluation metric is mAP@0.5 (YOLOv8 0.902, Mask R-CNN 0.920, SR 0.909, multiple-weed 0.860). Low mIoU/Dice vs high PA reflects background-dominated tiles.
